rewrites.comment: MUST come before the SPA catch-all below, or /api/* is swallowed and answered with index.html at 200 — axios would then parse HTML as a response (the T016 failure). Proxying the API through this origin is what removes the cross-origin call: the backend sends no CORS headers, so a browser could never read a direct response from it. This is a simpler public API boundary, not a security control — the backend stays directly reachable and its own auth and rate limiting remain the real controls.
